name: Zepa UI
summary: Copy-paste React hero sections, grids and animated landing-page blocks, installable with the shadcn CLI.
description: Zepa UI is a free copy-paste React component library for landing pages: 34 hero sections, 6 navbars, grid sections, animation blocks and single components like calendar, timeline and toast, each with a live demo and install command. Components install with the shadcn CLI; licensed MIT + Commons Clause (free to use, not to resell).
